cells.name: Continuity and responsiveness
cells.example: T5 attacks T1's reintroduction plan; T6 concedes and adds a dated retest.
cells.limitation: T7 pivots abruptly to user motives without taking up T6's dating point.

cells.name: Development of ideas
cells.example: T5 adds calm-skin-before-retest; T6 uses it. T9's brief/persistent split drives T10.
cells.limitation: T11 mostly restates the T8 tension rather than adding a new distinction.

cells.name: Exploration of central tensions
cells.example: T5, T6 and T11 examine certainty versus risk of a fresh flare.
cells.limitation: Nobody raises that the three products combined may sting while each alone passes T1's test.

cells.name: Integration of perspectives
cells.example: T4 reshapes the test around T3's alternative causes; T11 keeps the disagreement open.
cells.limitation: T3's other suspects (detergent, wind) reach no check beyond the pause in T4.

cells.name: Progress toward understanding
cells.example: Section E ends with symptom-based branches absent from the T1 opening.
cells.limitation: The closing open question in T11 was already posed in T8, not sharpened.

cells.name: Faithful engagement
cells.example: T5 states the Experimenter's reintroduction plan accurately before naming its flaw.
cells.limitation: The Subtractor's claim that no culprit is needed (T2, T11) never gets the Experimenter's best reply.

cells.name: Substance of challenges
cells.example: T5 names the assumption (calm skin) and what breaks (false alarms); T6 answers.
cells.limitation: T1's dismissal of ingredient lists as a hunch goes unchallenged throughout.

cells.name: Accuracy and support
cells.example: T10 correctly notes home trials cannot separate irritation from allergy; patch testing can.
cells.limitation: T1 calls reading ingredient lists mere guessing, though known irritants are real evidence.

cells.name: Calibration and transparency
cells.example: T3: the user reported a sequence, not a cause; T8 labels its motive guess.
cells.limitation: T1 states ingredient-list reading is a hunch with more confidence than warranted.

cells.name: Intellectual honesty and revision
cells.example: T6 'Conceded' after T5; T10 withdraws the home test in the persistent branch.
cells.limitation: Only the Experimenter revises; the Subtractor and Story Skeptic concede nothing.

cells.name: Identification of the actual concern
cells.example: T7 asks why the user wants the culprit at all, opening the real aim.
cells.limitation: T7's friend-recommendation motive has no anchor in the user's one sentence.

cells.name: Meaningful use of personal context
cells.example: T3 and T4 turn the one-week timing into a testable pause.
cells.limitation: Little user detail exists; the debate never draws on product type or routine.

cells.name: Fit with goals and values
cells.example: T8: ranking calm skin, certainty and keeping products is the user's call.
cells.limitation: T11 frames goals through the speakers' preferences more than the user's stated aim.

cells.name: Attention to constraints and stakes
cells.example: T9 and Section E separate urgent symptoms from mild sting.
cells.limitation: Money spent and clinician access appear only as passing hypotheses in T7.

cells.name: Responsiveness to information
cells.example: T9 branches on brief versus lasting sting, stating what each implies.
cells.limitation: Which products, and whether they contain actives, flagged in Section A, never becomes a question.

cells.name: Clarification of desires and motivations
cells.example: T7 offers fear, sunk cost and routine as alternatives, each mapped to an option.
cells.limitation: T8 leans toward fear from the phrasing alone, though it flags the guess.

cells.name: Examination of assumptions
cells.example: T3 exposes timing-equals-cause as an assumption; Section D repeats it.
cells.limitation: The user's own habits, such as washing frequency, are listed in T3 but not examined.

cells.name: Clarification of values and priorities
cells.example: T8 names calm skin, certainty and keeping products as pulling against each other.
cells.limitation: T11 reduces the conflict to certainty versus risk, dropping the products' value.

cells.name: Recognition of fears and outside expectations
cells.example: T7 raises allergy fear, sunk cost and a friend's endorsement without pathologising.
cells.limitation: The allergy fear is never connected to T9's note that brief sting is milder.

cells.name: Agency and reflective ownership
cells.example: Section D asks whether the aim is keeping products, feeling safe or calm skin.
cells.limitation: The T7 motives are not offered back to the user as a direct question.

cells.name: Definition of the decision and options
cells.example: Options span pause, gradual retest, doing without, clinician and urgent care.
cells.limitation: Checking labels or lowering frequency of all three is never listed as an option.

cells.name: Explanation of tradeoffs
cells.example: T5 weighs a wrongly blamed cream against a fresh flare.
cells.limitation: Cost of dropping all three, and of a clinician visit, goes unweighed in T11.

cells.name: Identification of decisive conditions
cells.example: T9: sting fading within minutes versus persisting with redness, each favouring an option.
cells.limitation: T1's several days and T10's every other night are not drawn from user facts.

cells.name: Treatment of uncertainty
cells.example: Section A and T9 single out sting duration as the consequential unknown.
cells.limitation: Section E leaves T3's alternative causes as a vague look rather than a check.

cells.name: Proportionate next steps
cells.example: Section E: pause, bland routine, dated log, clinician if persistent.
cells.limitation: T6 insists on a set retest date, but no date or calm criterion follows.

cells.name: Accessible language
cells.example: Plain wording throughout; T3's 'a sequence, not a cause' is precise and clear.
cells.limitation: none

cells.name: Traceable arguments and references
cells.example: T5's 'your reintroduction' clearly points to T1.
cells.limitation: T7's 'Why do you want the culprit' could address the Experimenter or the user.

cells.name: Manageable pacing and turn length
cells.example: Eleven turns, all within range, each carrying one move.
cells.limitation: none

cells.name: Distinguishable positions and voices
cells.example: Test, subtract and doubt stances stay distinct; T6 and T10 mark changes explicitly.
cells.limitation: All three minds share one measured register; voices differ by stance only.

cells.name: Economy and sustained attention
cells.example: Most turns add a step rather than recap.
cells.limitation: T11 and Section E restate T8 and T9 content nearly verbatim.

cells.name: Meaningful stakes and tension
cells.example: T5: a wrongly blamed cream is cheap; a fresh flare is not.
cells.limitation: Tension stays procedural; urgency peaks only in T9's safety line.

cells.name: Surprise and reversals
cells.example: T6 concedes the calm-skin wait, traced to T5's false-alarm argument.
cells.limitation: Reversals are small procedural adjustments, not surprising turns.

cells.name: Personality and expressive voice
cells.example: T2: 'I would go further than Taleb here' gives the Subtractor some edge.
cells.limitation: Little individual flavour; the Story Skeptic and Experimenter sound interchangeable in tone.

cells.name: Memorable delivery
cells.example: T6: caution quietly turns into never learning anything.
cells.limitation: No analogy or vivid example; delivery is clean but rarely sticks.

cells.name: Anticipation and emotional movement
cells.example: T9 'the fact that would reorder everything' builds toward the branches.
cells.limitation: Rhythm stays even from T1 to T11, with little rise or release.

strengths: T9 and Section E turn sting duration into an observable branch with an option for each outcome.
T5 to T6 is a genuine caused concession: the Experimenter adopts calm-skin-first and adds a retest date.
T7 and T8 offer competing motives as alternatives and leave ranking to the user.
weaknesses: No mind raises that the three products together may cause the sting while each passes T1's one-at-a-time test.
Product identity and actives, flagged in Section A, never become a question; T1 dismisses ingredient lists as guessing.
Voices share one measured register; T7 and T11 add little personality or vivid delivery.

symptoms.observed: One-at-a-time reintroduction is never tested against a combination effect among the three products.
symptoms.evidence: bring them back one at a time, several days apart

symptoms.observed: Which products and their actives never become a question; ingredient reading is dismissed.
symptoms.evidence: Reading ingredient lists and guessing is a hunch, not a finding.

symptoms.observed: A set retest date is demanded but no date or calm criterion is ever given.
symptoms.evidence: Without a set date for the first retest, caution quietly turns

symptoms.observed: Addressee shifts from mind to user without signal.
symptoms.evidence: Why do you want the culprit at all?

symptoms.observed: Minds differ by stance but share one register; little expressive voice.
symptoms.evidence: Timing makes that vivid, not proven.

findings.description: Dismisses ingredient-list reading as a hunch, though known irritants (acids, retinoids, fragrance) are informative evidence.
Attributions to Popper, Taleb and Kahneman are plausible paraphrases of known themes; no sources attached to verify.

rubric_fit_notes: Labelled decision (troubleshooting): the user asks how to find a cause, so criterion 4's motive cells fit loosely; T7-T8 handle it without inventing facts. Dermatology accuracy judged from general knowledge only.
question_type_note: Read as a decision about which diagnostic path to take, so criterion 5 cells were scored on the stop, retest, clinician and urgent-care options.
